sum: Georgia Banking Company, Inc. engages in banking business to individual, business, and commercial customers in Atlanta, Georgia. It provides accounts, savings, certificate of deposits, loan payments, mortgage lending, and digital and private banking services to individuals. The company also offers business accounts, savings, digital banking, online loan payment, and treasury solutions to businesses. In addition, it provides construction loans, real estate lending, payments, digital banking, online payments, and other services. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
